name: django-scaffold-frontend
description: django-scaffold 前端样式构建链（Tailwind CSS v4 + DaisyUI）

scripts.build: npm run build:admin && mkdir -p static/css/dist && tailwindcss -i static/css/base.css -o static/css/dist/base.css --minify
scripts.build:admin: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('static/js/dist', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/echarts/dist/echarts.min.js', 'static/js/dist/echarts.min.js')"
scripts.build:win: npm run build:admin && (if not exist "static\css\dist" mkdir "static\css\dist") && tailwindcss -i static/css/base.css -o static/css/dist/base.css --minify
scripts.dev:win: if not exist "static\css\dist" mkdir "static\css\dist" && tailwindcss -i static/css/base.css -o static/css/dist/base.css --watch
